title: Gift that keeps on giving!
text: Bought this for my 18 year old adventurous Foodie son.  The first box was Italy, and he just received the second box which was Taiwan... He absolutely Loves these!! I subscribed to the small box which is perfect for small tastes!  It has 3-4 larger sized treats and a handful of smaller pieces which he always wants us to share with him!  He gets excited to see which Country the box is from, and has started collecting the postcard pictures that come with each box that are of whichever Country the box theme is! If you're looking for a box with more than just a tasting go with the larger one, the small one is enough for us but it might not be for everyone! This was definately an interesting present that my son enjoys getting and unboxing on video with his friends ( who are always asking how they can get these too! )
label: positive
